skills.name: calendar
skills.description: Manage calendar events, agendas, reminders, and recurring schedules by authoring Remind entries directly with the LLM.

skills.name: daily-briefing

skills.name: document-intelligence
skills.description: Capture, unlock, OCR, search, and inspect evidence documents, YouTube video transcripts, and video summaries in the OpenLia Ingestion Vault across embedded and standalone deployments.
